description.value: North Country Inn & Suites is a family-run motel established in 1984, situated in the heart of downtown Vanderhoof — the geographical centre of British Columbia — along Highway 16 between Prince George and Prince Rupert. The 40-room property spans four buildings and includes an on-site restaurant locally known as the 'Log House,' serving Canadian-European cuisine from breakfast through dinner. Its central location puts guests within walking distance of shopping and parks, making it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the Highway 16 corridor.
